entities.summary: Alexander Lenard was a Hungarian physician, writer, translator, painter, musician, poet and occasional language instructor. He was born in Budapest, Hungary and died in Dona Emma, in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. He is best known as the Latin translator of A. A. Milne's Winnie the Pooh. He wrote non-fiction and translated fiction and non fiction in German, Latin, Hungarian, Italian and English.
